messages.content: I'm 29 and rolled my ankle stepping off a low garden border this morning. It is mildly sore on the outside and the swelling is small. There is no open wound, numbness, or crooked shape. The bony tips and back edges of both ankle bumps do not hurt when I touch them, and I have no pain across the middle of my foot. I took at least four steps immediately afterward and can still take four steps now. What should I do next?
